questions.question: What history does Psalm 105 recount?
options: God's creation of the whole wide world in the very beginning of all the days
God's faithfulness to his covenant from Abraham through the exodus and the land
God's coming judgment upon all of the nations at the very end of the present age
God's gracious choosing of David from the sheepfold to be king over all Israel
questions.answer: God's faithfulness to his covenant from Abraham through the exodus and the land

questions.question: Whom did God send ahead of Israel into Egypt?
The psalm calls people to remember the wondrous works that God has done.
Oh give thanks to the LORD; call upon his _____; make known his deeds!
He remembers his _____ forever, the word that he commanded for a thousand generations.
